# `acquireReleaseDisposable`

Suggests Effect.acquireDisposable when Effect.acquireRelease only invokes the acquired resource's disposal protocol

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377119` |
| Language Service name | `acquireReleaseDisposable` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/acquire-release-disposable` |

## Preview

```ts
/// <reference lib="esnext.disposable" />
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const acquire: Effect.Effect<AsyncDisposable>

export const resource = Effect.acquireRelease(
/**
                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(acquire-release-disposable): `Effect.acquireDisposable` expresses this disposable resource acquisition more directly than `Effect.acquireRelease` with a manual disposal finalizer.
*/
  acquire,
  (resource) => Effect.promise(() => resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]())
)
```
